{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ezran pirates''' were a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-allied [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang that was active during the [[Galactic War]] and operated out of the [[Ezran system/Legends|Ezran system]] until the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Battle of the Ezran system|wiped them out]].
